description: List every chain on the RobotBase roster with its state. When to use: the user asks which chains are supported, which nodes are online, or where to start. Do not use: for one chain's live health call chain_status; for what a node can and cannot answer call robotbase_capabilities. Returns: chains[], each {chain, tier (live|provisioning|planned), ok, synced, height, state}.
name: list_chains
title: List Chains
